title: Chapter 23 Ao Qing Recognizes The Master
content:
Chapter 23 Ao Qing Recognizes The Master

Hearing this, everyone looked solemn.

Yes, there is no place in this city that does not show its supreme aura.

Then what kind of person is the owner of this huge city?

It must not be as simple as the Emperor of Heaven.

Above the Emperor of Heaven? !

That is a bit hard to describe. After all, they can't even become the Emperor of Heaven, let alone above the Emperor of Heaven.

In the corner, Ao Qing looked at everyone with disdain.

He was the only alien present, and the only one above the Saint King.

Noticing Ao Qing, Ye Hanshuang turned his head and looked over.

"Are you from the Ice Dragon Clan?"

"Nonsense."

Ye Hanshuang frowned slightly. Sure enough, the Dragon Clan has such a bad temper.

But Ye Hanshuang was not angry, because she thought of the monster with the blood of the Ice Phoenix.

"Do you know the whereabouts of the person with the blood of the Ice Phoenix?"

Ye Hanshuang asked tentatively.

Hearing this, Ao Qing's pupils shrank slightly.

"That's my master!"

"What?!"

All of a sudden, everyone in the hall looked at Ao Qing.

Ao Qing's strength was beyond doubt, even stronger than any of them.

Moreover, before they rose to power, they knew about the giant dragon in Zhenlong Valley.

It can be said that Ao Qing was their predecessor.

"Master? What do you mean?"

Ye Hanshuang asked.

She originally wanted to take the person with the blood of the Ice Phoenix as a disciple, because only her Hanji Palace was qualified to cultivate the blood of the Ice Phoenix.

And now it seems that if the person with the blood of the Ice Phoenix is the master of the Ice Dragon, then this matter may be ruined.

After all, this dragon is not simple at all.

Ao Qing did not answer, and at this moment, a crisp footsteps suddenly sounded from the hall.

The footsteps were not loud, but they went straight into people's hearts.

For a moment, everyone was tense and looked straight into the depths of the hall.

The next moment, a middle-aged man with a smile slowly walked into the hall.

Although they did not feel any breath from the middle-aged man, they did not dare to be careless at all.

At this time, Lu Daosheng had already sat in his seat.

"Who are you?"

Seeing Lu Daosheng, the drunk old man frowned.

Hearing this, everyone around looked at the drunk old man with contempt.

Is there any need to guess this person's identity?

"Welcome to my deserted city."

Lu Daosheng did not answer, but spoke directly.

Hearing this, everyone was shocked.

Sure enough.

Is this the Lord of the Deserted City?

It's really not simple.

"Hello, Lord of the Deserted City, I am from the Nangong family, my name is Nangong Fang."

Nangong Fang was the first to introduce himself.

Suddenly, the drunk old man also said: "My name is Zui Laodao, and everyone calls me Zui Laoweng."

"My name is Shi Tianzhi, the Lord of Tianzhi City."

"Ye Hanshuang, the Lord of Hanji Palace."

"Jian Lingfeng, they all call me Broken Sword Old Man."

Soon, only Ao Qing was left in the hall.

Suddenly, everyone looked at Ao Qing.

Including Lu Daosheng.

Looking at the eyes of everyone, Ao Qing was speechless. He didn't want to say anything because his goal was only his master.

From beginning to end, he didn't care about this city.

Because, he just wanted to go home.

"Ao Qing."

Ao Qing said lightly.

After listening to everyone's self-introduction, Lu Daosheng nodded slightly.

"Lu Daosheng, the Lord of Huangcheng, if you have any questions, you can ask me."

Lu Daosheng smiled slightly.

Looking at Lu Daosheng without any airs, giving people a feeling of being bathed in spring breeze.

Everyone felt relieved, and there was a little more respect in their eyes when they looked at Lu Daosheng.

This is what a real big shot should look like.

"Lord of the Wasteland City, I want to know where the person with the blood of the Ice Phoenix is?"

Hearing Lu Daosheng's words, Ao Qing spoke first.

On the side, Nangong Fang, who was about to ask, was speechless.

He was so hesitant in introducing himself just now, but now he is so active in asking questions.

"Ice Phoenix blood? Are you looking for my daughter? Is there something?"

Boom!

Suddenly, everyone in the hall was stunned.

The person with the blood of the Ice Phoenix turned out to be the daughter of the Lord of this Supreme City.

At this moment, Ye Hanshuang's heart suddenly became very complicated.

She actually wanted to accept him as a disciple, but she was afraid that he would look down on her small Hanji Palace.

Indeed, Hanji Palace is a dominant force in the outside world, but in front of this Wasteland City, it is like a child.

"Um, Lord City Lord, it's like this, I want to recognize your daughter as my master."

Hearing that his master was actually the daughter of the man in front of him, Ao Qing's tone and address became respectful.

The next moment, two figures slowly walked in from outside the hall.

It was Lu Xue and Gu Chen.

"It's you!"

Seeing Gu Chen, Ao Qing was a little surprised.

A million years ago, Gu Chen had been to Zhenlong Valley and had met Ao Qing once.

Ao Qing still remembered Gu Chen, but he thought that the other party had already fallen.

Because the other party was just a cultivator in the Divine Mansion Realm at that time.

But now, the other party has made so much progress.

"Long time no see."

Seeing Ao Qing, Gu Chen smiled slightly.

Aside, Lu Xue looked at Ao Qing curiously.

She just heard that the other party wanted to recognize her as the master.

At the same time, everyone around was looking at Lu Xue and Gu Chen curiously.

"Master! I finally see you!"

At this time, Ao Qing suddenly hugged Lu Xue's thigh and said in a mess.

This scene made everyone a little confused.

At the top, Lu Daosheng was also like this.

As for such a big reaction?

"Oh, you, you get up first."

Lu Xue's face was slightly red, and she hurriedly wanted to push Ao Qing away.

But unexpectedly, her quasi-emperor cultivation could not move Ao Qing at all.

Buzz——

Suddenly, a gentle force directly pulled Ao Qing aside.

"City Lord."

"Dad."

Everyone looked at Lu Daosheng with respect in their eyes.

"Ao Qing, I have no objection to you recognizing my daughter as your master. This matter will be decided by my daughter herself."

Ao Qing recognizing Lu Xue as your master is good for Lu Xue. The only disadvantage may be that she will bear the cause and effect of Ao Qing.

But it's okay, with him here, even if the sky falls, he can still hold it up.

"Master,"

Hearing Lu Daosheng's words, Ao Qing immediately looked at Lu Xue with a pleading look.

Everyone on the side was envious.

This is a real dragon, and it's an ice dragon. It's not just about having strong strength to take in a dragon.

Obviously, the lord of this deserted city can fully afford it.

"Emm, then okay, I'll take you in reluctantly."

Lu Xue was silent for a moment, hesitantly said.

The main reason was that her own father didn't refuse, so she agreed.

It doesn't matter whether she has this ice dragon or not.

When they heard this, everyone's mouth twitched slightly.

Reluctantly,

If you don't want to, don't force it too much.

It's a pity that even if Lu Xue doesn't want to, it's not their turn.

"Thank you, master, for taking me in!"

Then, a white light appeared on Ao Qing's forehead, and the next moment, the white light floated out and slowly imprinted on Lu Xue's arm.

Suddenly, Lu Xue felt a connection between her and Ao Qing.

Lu Xue opened her mouth slightly. She didn't expect that this ice dragon would be so powerful.

The next moment, Ao Qing turned into a little dragon and coiled on Lu Xue's arm.
